# Functional Requirements Document — Application

### Functional Requirement Document (FRD)

#### Requirement ID
• FRD-001

#### Title
• Data Processing and Aggregation for Customer and Order Data

#### Description
• The application will process customer and order data from CSV files, perform data cleansing, and load the data into Delta tables. It will then create an "ordersummary" table using SCD Type 2, aggregate spend data by customer, and store it in a "customeraggregatespend" table.

#### Preconditions
• The input CSV files for customer and order data are available at the specified locations.
• The necessary catalog and schema exist in the Databricks environment.

#### Main Flow / Functional Steps

• **Step 1: Read Source CSV Data**
  • Read customer data from `/Volumes/gen_ai_poc_databrickscoe/sdlc_wizard/customerdata`.
  • Read order data from `/Volumes/gen_ai_poc_databrickscoe/sdlc_wizard/orderdata`.
  • Load the data into Delta tables named "customer" and "order".

• **Step 2: Data Cleansing**
  • Remove records with "Null" or Null values from both "customer" and "order" tables.
  • Remove duplicate records from both "customer" and "order" tables.

• **Step 3: Create ordersummary Table**
  • Check if the "ordersummary" table exists in the catalog "gen_ai_poc_databrickscoe" and schema "sdlc_wizard".
  • If it does not exist, create it with the schema: CustId, Name, EmailId, Region, OrderId, ItemName, PricePerUnit, Qty, Date.

• **Step 4: Load ordersummary Table**
  • Join the "customer" and "order" tables on the "CustId" field.
  • Load the joined data into the "ordersummary" table using SCD Type 2 logic.

• **Step 5: Implement SCD Type 2 Logic for ordersummary Table**
  • When there is a change in the "customer" table, update the "ordersummary" table accordingly.
  • For updated records, mark the old records as Inactive and new records as Active.
  • Update the StartDate and EndDate fields for the affected records.

• **Step 6: Create customeraggregatespend Table**
  • Check if the "customeraggregatespend" table exists in the catalog "gen_ai_poc_databrickscoe" and schema "sdlc_wizard".
  • If it does not exist, create it with the columns: "Name", "TotalAmount", and "Date".

• **Step 7: Aggregate and Load Data into customeraggregatespend Table**
  • Aggregate the "TotalAmount" (calculated as PricePerUnit * Qty) from the "ordersummary" table.
  • Group the aggregated data by "Name" and "Date".
  • Load the aggregated data into the "customeraggregatespend" table.

#### Postconditions
• The "ordersummary" and "customeraggregatespend" tables are populated with the processed and aggregated data.

#### Assumptions and Dependencies
• The input CSV files are correctly formatted and available at the specified paths.
• The Databricks environment is properly configured with the necessary catalog and schema.
